mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies and a temperature of 60 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park. The moon is in its first quarter phase, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 56 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
Important road work begins September 23 with chip sealing on Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue, while the Plan Commission is set to review several development projects on October 5.
Today is packed with local fun including the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival and Bike the Barns, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a serious incident on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired and a 19-year-old suspect was taken into custody.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available at this time.
